systems.country_label: كابل الألياف البصرية بين غات وتهالة
systems.owner: Hatef Libya (Libya Telecom & Technology LPTIC group)
systems.tiers: Almadar Aljadid and Libyana services in Ghat and Tahala municipalities

note: Flood cut a local fibre link between Ghat and Tahala (south-west) in May 2026, with VSAT backup restoring 11 of 12 sites; the document does not say it is part of a capital-to-regions national backbone, so no reach or access fact.
The 12,000-13,000 km network is a plan; only fibre extending from Benghazi toward Kufra is mentioned, with no contract or in-service link to the capital stated.
A 16,000 km fibre network is only a plan of O3, with no contract or works stated.
Fibre reaches the Egyptian border; no domestic backbone between capital and regions stated.
National backbone only planned; no contract or works stated.
